name: mql5-codegraph-intelligence
description: Evidence-backed local MQL5 intelligence with bounded compiler-log correlation

interface.shortDescription: Navigate MQL5 projects with evidence-backed graph tools.
interface.longDescription: Index trusted local MQL5 repositories in memory, query symbols and relationships, trace impact and paths, correlate bounded compiler logs, and assemble AI context without modifying source files.
defaultPrompt: Index this MQL5 project and explain its architecture.
Trace the impact of changing this MQL5 symbol.
Correlate this project's supplied MetaEditor compiler log.
Run the MQL5 static-analysis release gate.
